title: Chapter 158 The Glory Of Yan Kingdom
content:
Chapter 158 The Glory Of Yan Kingdom

When cavalry confront each other, the long is very long, and the short is also very short.

The charging speed of the war horse is very fast, and the distance of just a few miles is only a few minutes for a fast-charging war horse.

The reason why they were able to fight for such a long time was that apart from the confrontation between the two armies, the speed of charge was inevitably reduced. In addition, there were too many troops, tens of thousands of people, and they were still cavalry, spreading out for more than ten miles.

Such a wide battlefield, how could it be possible to rush through at once, if you want to cross, there are constant enemy soldiers blocking you along the way, and the distance is far enough.

But even with these problems, he finished the first confrontation within half an hour, and after that, the cavalry from the two sides separated in their respective directions after a round of fighting.

However, in just half an hour, the plain that was originally filled with countless cavalry was instantly empty and sparse.

Originally there were more than 30,000 Yan State cavalry, but only a little over 10,000 remained, and all of them were wounded, looking horrible.

However, the more than 50,000 imperial cavalry did not lose much, but only 5,000 people were lying on the ground, which was not so obvious compared to his huge team.

"Damn it, am I going to lose here today? In my first battle, I made a promise to my father and king before I left the city, but now..." Yan Dan's expression was unwilling, and his whole body trembled.

He turned his head and looked at the Yan Kingdom cavalry behind him. This group of brave warriors followed him out of the city, but he did not bring them victory, nor did he accomplish any of his goals. defeat.

"Well, can it be that I deserve to die here today?" Yan Dan looked up at the sky and sighed.

Under the watchful eyes of the imperial cavalry, it was too difficult for him to escape with the 10,000 remnants.

The riding skills, war horses, and experience of the cavalry on both sides are not at the same level, although the soldiers of Yan State have worked very hard, desperately, and tried their best to fight.

However, the enemy's soldiers are not inferior to their own soldiers. They are better, stronger, more determined to fight, and more desperate.

Facing such an enemy must be a headache for any opponent!

However, I can still...

Yan Dan thought of this idea in his heart, but he quickly suppressed it, and it passed by in a flash, but this throbbing lingered in his heart all the time.

"Soldiers, it is I, Yan Dan, who is sorry for you. I can't give you the honor you deserve. Let you carry the glory of victory and step into Jicheng again with your heads held high. With the glory of Yan Kingdom, hold your heads high." Yan Dan spoke loudly, mobilizing her internal strength, and spreading her voice across the battlefield.

"Now, we can't escape. The group of people on the opposite side has surrounded us tightly, just like a pack of wolves staring at their prey. We can't get rid of it!" All Yan The soldiers of the country fell silent for a while when they heard the cruel words of their commander, Prince Yan.

"However, even if we can escape back, don't we just watch this group of people bullying our homeland, robbing our relatives, and trampling on our dignity as Yan people. Then we are like a dog, lingering alive , Hiding in that tall, thick, Ji City, seeking that trace of safety, trembling like a coward?" Yan Dan's voice was full of emotion, and at the end, he roared out, attracting all The soldier couldn't help being moved, with an angry look on his face.

"I, Yan Dan, make an oath here today, to live and die with you, until the last moment of the battle, even if we die, we must show our dignity as a Yan country, a man of Yan country!"

"At this moment, we are not for the king of Yan, let alone me, Yandan. I am for your family, and for your dignity as a man in Yan!" A long speech came out of Yandan's mouth. , His face flushed red, his whole body trembled, and he stopped talking after he finished speaking.

"Draw your sword and fight!"

Yan Dan swung his long sword, raised his head high, and rushed towards the Yu Guoren who were ready to start the second round of attack.

"Draw your sword and go to battle!" The morale of the Yan soldiers who had been low was re-energized by Yan Dan, their heads were already bleeding, and they only thought about the hearty battle at this moment.

Now that he heard the order from his commander-in-chief, he didn't care too much, so he rushed forward in a daze.

In the opposite camp, Zhao Yun and others looked at the soldiers of the Yan State, their morale once again revived, and they became fearless again, feeling a burst of surprise.

"Are these the soldiers of Yan State? For their own country, for their own honor, they can live and die without fear!" Zhao Yun exclaimed.

"It's just a struggle. These bereaved dogs, if you come one, I, Zhang Fei, will poke one, if you come a pair, I, Zhang Fei, will poke a bunch!" If Zhang Fei heard Zhao Yun's words, Zhang Fei was not happy, but eager to try again beat him up.

Just now Zhang Fei had a fight with Yan Dan. They are both first-class masters, but Yan Dan's dexterous body skills forced him to defend. counterattacked.

"With such warriors, if the King of Yan can make good use of them, how can our imperial country be able to achieve its prosperity today, and how can the Yan country end up like this!" Xu Huang, who always cherishes loyalty and courage, and talks about righteousness, sighs .

"It's time to end this farce. These weak people are destined to perish after following the wrong master. It's just a matter of time!" Zhang Liao said coldly. For these, the so-called loyalty and the so-called honor have nothing to do with him. It seems that without a good platform for them to play, everything is just a fake.

The most important thing now is to kill these enemies quickly so that they can go back and report to their Emperor. He has not forgotten how angry His Majesty was when they were inside!

It has been delayed for a long time now, and if it continues to delay, he may be punished if he waits for others. This is not what he wants to see.

"The whole army obeys orders, for His Majesty, for the sake of the country, for our honor and duty as soldiers, attack, defeat the weak, and use their heads and blood to forge our brilliance!"

Following Zhang Liao's order, the soldiers of the Imperial Kingdom, who were readying their horses, waved their whips again, and charged forward without any hesitation, holding up the weapons in their hands.

"Long live Your Majesty! Yuguo wins!"

Shouting the slogan that they have practiced many times, this is the slogan that their majesty specially asked them to say every morning, noon and night, before eating, and before going to bed, in order to brainwash them.

At this moment it was finally time for them to perform their best. Tens of thousands of people shouted in unison. The momentum that shook the world weakened the morale of the Yan people who were already extremely strong on the opposite side.
